messages.subject: Creating publishable tables with model estimates, pvalues, etc.
parts:
Good afternoon, 

I am trying to create publishable tables that show model estimates, p.values, etc. from pcount models. I have been trying to use several packages and functions, specifically the tab_model() function in the sjPlot package but have not been successful. With this function I keep receiving the error "Error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors". I was wondering if anyone could push me in the right direction of packages/functions (Have attempted using tables, texreg and xtable packages), or if they have experience with fixing this error. 

Thank you in advance, 
Ty
